definitions.gloss: analogy; inference by analogy; analogical reasoning
definitions.explanation: The process of reasoning from known similarities to infer additional similarities. Drawing conclusions about something based on its resemblance to something else.

examples.japanese: {類推|るいすい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。

⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{類推|るいすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Reasoning by analogy from past cases, the result will likely be the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{類推|るいすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}しよう→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧とした。
examples.english: I tried to understand the grammar of the new language by drawing analogies from my knowledge of other languages.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({類推|るいすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Common in academic, logical, and linguistic contexts. In linguistics, {類推|るいすい} refers to the process by which irregular forms are regularized based on patterns from similar words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {類推|るいすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reason by analogy)
- {類推|るいすい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from analogy)
- {類推|るいすい}⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧ (analogical interpretation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推測|すいそく}→推測：12821_suisoku⟧: conjecture, guess — broader meaning, not necessarily based on analogy
- ⟦{推論|すいろん}→推論：20773_suiron⟧: inference, deduction — more general logical reasoning
